overloadPatches.semanticRole: Inserts a new item (with its own reference number, text, and optional sublist) into a hierarchical list before a given item, the last-added item, or the currently selected item.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when list should be interpreted as an object name (string) identifying a form representation of the list; when * is omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number (ListRef).

jointConstraints.rule: Although both are individually optional, sublist and expanded must be passed together (or both omitted); passing only one is invalid.

constraints: Required to use the object-name (starred) form of list, rather than the ListRef form, if the same hierarchical list has several representations and you need to insert relative to that representation's own current item; a starless ListRef call would be ambiguous in that case.

beforeItemRef may be an actual item reference number, 0 to mean the last item added to the list, or the * literal to mean the currently selected item; if no item matches the given reference number, the command does nothing.
Since 4D v16 R4, itemText can be the ak standard action title constant to automatically use the localized name of the associated standard action.
